Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
1st August 1918

Sir,
The City and Chapei Police were paid on 31st ultimo.
The troops in Woosung and the Arsenal expect to be paid
to-day.
There is some dissatisfaction among the troops in
Chapei at present. It appears a rumour is current amongst
them that they will soon be transferred to the North,
and they do not wish to go.
Zoo Koh Liang, Chief of the local Chinese Police,
has given instructions that constables on street duty
are not to carry arms during the day, but they must
carry truncheons instead.
Four Republican papers are printed in red to-day.

Your obedient servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

1/8/16
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处 协力同心）
警务处。
（侦探股）
1918年8月1日

先生，
华界及闸北警队已于上月31日发饷。
驻吴淞及兵工厂之部队预计今日发饷。
目前闸北部队中存在一些不满情绪。据悉，军中流传着他们即将被调往北方的谣言，而他们不愿前往。
当地华捕督察长朱古良（Zoo Koh Liang，音译）已下达指令，日间在街头执勤的巡捕不得携带枪械，但必须携带警棍。
今日有四份共和派报纸以红色字体印刷出版。

您顺从的仆人，
总探长。

警务处总监上尉。
